accepted.because: No script of the realization performs this fault, so the find Queries whose paths take it are not lowered; realizing faults belongs to the later spec that declares typed faults as environment actions (fn-120 Boundaries).

The server answers this request here with a rejection (FailedPrecondition, NotFound or an already-started error), and the Model leaves the pair disabled: a rejecting row adds rows to the table, so it waits for a spec that lifts fn-112's behavior freeze (fn-112 Decision Context, Model gaps).
A fault is the environment's and no request the server answers: where the Model disables it the fault cannot happen, which the author decided.

No same-step Property, transition claim or progress claim reads this class's results yet; the Model's Queries pin other classes, and a claim for it is new Model work left to the spec that takes claim coverage, under fn-112's behavior freeze (fn-112 Decision Context, Model gaps).
